description.zh: 批量重命名：控件模式用规则链和标志位描述怎么改，文本模式把文件集当缓冲区直接编辑。窗口外观跟随 Win顺 的界面风格
description.en: Bulk rename: control mode describes the change with rule chains and flags, text mode lets you edit the file set as a buffer. The window follows Win顺's interface style

description.zh: rename <模式> [-> 替换] 直接预览并改名（如 rename photo_ -> holiday_，或 rename 报告 -> 2026报告）；也可以选中文件后从右键菜单进入窗口逐项预览
description.en: rename <pattern> [-> replace] previews and renames right in the box (e.g. rename photo_ -> holiday_, or rename 报告 -> 2026报告); or select files and pick Rename… from the menu for the full window

hint.zh: 模式 [-> 替换]，或选中文件用
